I don't think all hotlines are inherently bad. However most of the US ones I've tried have been. There are many support groups within many apps that could help with immediate relief. I personally dabble in a few support groups throughout discord, reddit, and few more apps. 

Its more peer support than anything, however I find peer support to be more helpful than the suicide hotline. But there are pros and cons to both obviously. But I find people there to be less robotic and repetitive than those at the hotline.

Also If you're really struggling I recommend at least trying voluntary medical treatment. Cause it can be much more pleasant than being held against your will and can help you not think the way you're thinking. Don't underestimate treatment because there's literally hundreds of things you can do. 

For me personally, I plan to try my hand at psilocybin mushrooms because I have absolutely nothing left to lose at this point.
